summary: v11.0.8.09 Enterprise Web Release: High-Performance Item Master Reset & Refresh, FormDirtyTracker Search Exemption, Resilient Returns Loading & Complete Table Census
highlights: 1. High-Performance Item Master: Hardened resetFilters() and refreshItems() with debounced timer clearing, cache invalidation, and button state management to eliminate freezes.

2. FormDirtyTracker Search Exemption: Omnisearches, table filters, search inputs, and table headers are strictly exempted from dirty form tracking, preventing unintended page refresh locks and navigation aborts.
3. Stock Register Instant Refresh: views/inventory.html and views/item-master.html now provide visual spinner feedback and dedicated server cache invalidation.
4. Resilient Returns Register: Added authoritative summary recovery so existing returns (SAL-RET-2026-0002) always render immediately regardless of backend date filter formatting differences.

5. Instant Create Return Modal: Synchronously populates invoice options from in-memory sales cache, pre-selects the source invoice, ensures manual invoice input mode works smoothly, and eliminates modal freezes.
6. Table Census Architecture: Complete audit of all 103 tables with 13 core registers fully paginated at 25 items/page.
